'''Sniper One''' was a [[Void Jumper]] of the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]] who participated in the [[assault on the New Jedi Temple]]. While [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Gef Olazon]] were breaking through the corridors of the [[New Jedi Temple]], the [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] ensured that their backtrail was clear of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].
